title: Marionette
subtitle: Gesture-controlled Spotify player
overview: Conducting music with your hands — a sentence that sounds better than the engineering behind it deserves.
body: Conducting music with your hands, which is a sentence that sounds better than the engineering behind it deserves — but the engineering is the part I'm proud of.

MediaPipe handles hand landmark detection, and a KNN classifier maps gestures to playback controls. The piece I actually designed was the feature vector: raw landmark coordinates are useless for classification because they encode where your hand is and how big it appears, not what shape it's making. A custom normalised feature vector strips out position and scale so the classifier learns gesture geometry instead of memorising your webcam setup.
